title: Core placement preserves public exports and validates physical paths
summary: Classify core modules by responsibility while treating export compatibility, physical runtime paths and compiled graph freshness as separate checks.
hint_triggers: Read imports, consumers and initialization before moving a core module. Keep public export keys stable while remapping targets, move associated tests and native helpers, and register domain ownership plus justified root boundaries in core_placement. Audit embedded child imports, query-suffixed reevaluation and source/dist path construction separately. Clean-build before dependency or foundation-weight gates so obsolete emitted modules cannot distort the graph. Preserve cycle and weight budgets. Freeze source for final failed-and-affected regression reruns; a repair-time full-suite discovery run alone is not a final green claim.
